newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-GERMANY'S KOEPKE DOUBTFUL FOR CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GERMANY'S KOEPKE DOUBTFUL FOR CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Germany goalkeeper Andreas Koepke is doubtful for his country's World Cup qualifier against Ukraine later this month due to a calf muscle strain, his French club Marseille said on Friday.
The club said Koepke suffered the injury in the final minutes of Wednesday's 2-2 home draw with Montpellier.
"This kind of problem is always worrying," a club official said. "It could get better quickly, but it could also drag into a 15-day halt."
Germany meet Ukraine in their European zone group nine qualifier in Bremen on April 30.
